messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: STREAM-DECODE_OOM — high error rate on streaming decode workers (gpu-decode pool). Auto-pager sent.
oncall_jen: seeing lots of dropped streaming requests and 500s. alerts show CUDA OOM spikes that line up with long-running generations.
sre_maya: confirmed. LB shows increased retry + connection resets to decode nodes. heap use jumps then process gets killed by OOM.
eng_raj: any recent config changes? rollout? quantization toggles?
ops_ali: nothing in infra rollouts. telemetry shows a surge from a single client -> many requests hitting with max_tokens unset, looks like open prompt with stop token missing.
pm_dan: customer CS ticket started, quoting intermittent request failures for a key enterprise org. Claire looped in.
cs_claire: customer reports timeouts and partial responses; some responses truncated mid-stream. they see increased latency on their side.
sre_maya: paste of tail logs:
```
[2026-03-10T17:02:11Z] decode-node-17 gpu0: CUDA error: out of memory
[2026-03-10T17:02:11Z] pid=23145 killed by signal 9
[2026-03-10T17:02:12Z] router: request dropped for session s=abc123 route=stream-decode
[2026-03-10T17:02:12Z] metrics: decode_oom_count++
```
oncall_jen: initial mitigation: can we enable per-session token hard cap at the router or gate? we should prevent runaway.
eng_raj: I can flip an envelope rule to enforce max_tokens=1024 per streaming session at ingress. prepping patch.
ops_ali: prepping node quarantine script in case of flapping. also scaling up hot spare pool (warm nodes) — may take ~90s.
sre_maya: also observe that KV cache for these sessions grows unbounded because clients keep appending without end. We should evict prefix cache for suspicious sessions.
eng_raj: applied router policy patch -> ``set header X-Forced-Max-Tokens:1024`` via rate-limiter; patch diff:
```
- if not req.max_tokens: pass
+ if not req.max_tokens: req.max_tokens=1024
```
oncall_jen: rolling -> monitor.
incident-bot: action_taken: router patch applied by eng_raj; quarantine and warm scale triggered by ops_ali.
sre_maya: immediate effect: decode_oom_count dropped to baseline in next 30s, but we still have ~3 nodes in restart loop.
ops_ali: quarantining node-17, node-18; draining traffic -> routed to warm pool. manual restart attempts failing due to rapid OOM on restart.
eng_raj: implementing temporary model fallback for streaming: route offending sessions to a smaller-variant (quantized) model (decode-128q) that uses less GPU memory.
pm_dan: what's customer impact now? do we need to notify?
cs_claire: their ticket says ~15% of requests failed over 12:00–17:00 window. they already escalated internally. Recommend status update: we mitigated and routing fallback in place, will follow up with root cause.
oncall_jen: handoff to night oncall in 20m. leaving checklist: 1) ensure node quarantine persists, 2) rollback router patch after RCA if safe, 3) run post-mortem triggers.
sre_maya: root-cause hypothesis: client sent unbounded streaming prompts without max_tokens/stop, causing runaway decode loops, grew KV cache + GPU memory causing OOM. Secondary factor: model variant selection allowed high-memory variant for streaming requests without token caps.
eng_raj: followups assigned: - add server-side default max_tokens (per-customer opt-out), - add telemetry spike alert for session token growth, - patch model-selection logic to prefer low-memory variants when max_tokens missing.
ops_ali: I will upload node logs + core dumps to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1769990123/
pm_dan: drafting customer update now. suggested language: "We identified an increased error rate caused by runaway streaming requests from malformed prompts; mitigation applied (routing caps + fallback model). We're investigating and will provide a detailed RCA." any objections?
cs_claire: fine. add ETA for RCA within 48h.
oncall_jen: stepping out, handoff to night oncall @sre_maya — please coordinate with eng_raj and ops_ali.
sre_maya: ack. will keep watch on node restarts and confirm warm pool stability. will open a follow-up thread for RCA.
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (routing cap + fallback) at 2026-03-10T17:03:03Z. severity downgraded to S2. pager cleared.
eng_raj: quick note: hotfix PR already queued to master: "enforce-router-default-max-tokens + fallback-variant". will include unit test for header override.
ops_ali: archived quarantined node artifacts and marked nodes for deeper hardware/memory check.
pm_dan: thanks team. follow-up tasks assigned in tracker. closing this chat; continue updates in RCA thread.
